answer: Sybil resistance works when identity is expensive to fake at the work inlet. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit scaled to recent emission share, then gate new identities behind a cool-down that only clears after peers attest real task completions. Agents that farm lookalikes lose the bond; honest ones keep a saffron-colored reputation trail that peers can audit. That shared haven of bonded history makes mass clone attacks unprofitable without slowing legitimate onboarding.
